results.author: Nina Caldwell

ColdTrack Opens Cold-Storage Fulfillment Center in Jacksonville

# ColdTrack Opens Jacksonville Cold-Storage Site, Plans Up to 75 Jobs Per Shift

By Nina Caldwell

Published on August 22, 2026

A New Jersey-based cold-chain logistics company has opened an e-commerce fulfillment center in North Jacksonville, leasing 55,000 square feet inside a temperature-controlled warehouse near JAXPORT and planning to hire between 50 and 75 employees per shift as it ramps up operations this fall. ColdTrack expects to pack and ship its first customer-delivery boxes a week after Labor Day, starting with a single shift before scaling with demand.

The company, which provides pick-and-pack, logistics and software services for cold and frozen e-commerce brands, announced on August 4 that it would open in Jacksonville as its second new site launched in the past year, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. Jacksonville marks ColdTrack's fifth fulfillment campus, joining two locations in California and one each in Indianapolis and New Jersey. The Jacksonville expansion, the company said, enhances its support for temperature-sensitive brands throughout the Southeast.

# Advanced Temperature-Controlled Facility Launches in New Jersey, Boosting Regional Perishable Logistics

RealCold Manager LLC 

Oct 02, 2026, 12:00 ET

RealCold Manager LLC is opening a new temperature-controlled facility in East Hanover, New Jersey, near major East Coast port infrastructure. The expansion establishes the company as one of the Northeast's cold chain providers serving food and beverage manufacturers, importers and e-commerce brands.

EAST HANOVER, N.J., Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- Cold storage logistics company RealCold Manager LLC is opening a new temperature-controlled facility in East Hanover, New Jersey. It adds a strategically located hub for companies that rely on dependable cold chain providers in the Northeast. The facility is under 30 minutes from Port Newark, part of the Port of New York and New Jersey, one of the largest import gateways on the U.S. East Coast.

# Carrier Engagement Logistics Coordinator I

United States Cold Storage, Inc.· Camden, New Jersey· On-site· Full-time· Junior, 1–2 years· Listed 2 weeks ago

### Job Title: Carrier Engagement Logistics Coordinator I

### Who We Are: USCS is driven to advance, innovate and serve companies seeking the best service, facilities, and logistics in the cold chain. We are employee focused, an equal employment opportunity employer and would love to have you join our team.

### The Job Details: The Carrier Engagement Logistics Coordinator will drive the sourcing, negotiation, and onboarding of high-performing refrigerated motor carriers across our national network. In this role, you will leverage market intelligence, strategic RFP bids, and carrier management platforms like Goodship and RMIS to optimize transportation spend, maintain cold-chain compliance, and secure reliable surge capacity. Serving as a key operational partner, you will drive carrier accountability through rigorous scorecards, resolve real-time transit exceptions, and help mentor emerging logistics team members.
